title: Record that monotone selected entrances miss the rank-8/u2 16-child c…
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Negative result. No new κ. The selected conditional exponent stays `60403/20000000` (`0.00302015`).

On the selected k8 register file, with pinned entrances and monotone nested frames in \(\mathbb{F}_2^9\), no rank-at-most-8 paid profile of mass 5586 meets the u=2 nine-call moment at \(a = 1/98\). The ideal cell `{8:698, 2:1}` needs 698 rank-8 children. These entrances supply 648 monotone slots. The minimum feasible profile is `{8:648, 5:32, 4:24, 1:146}`. Its pooled moment, with idle `{51:272, 46:1}`, has certified bounds strictly above 1.

A comparison that gives each of the eight centre registers three rank-8 steps has histogram `{8:664, 5:32, 4:24, 1:18}`. The bare moment is below 1, and one aggregate rank-1 child pushes it above 1. That comparison is an upper model on the same eight centre indices. It is a changed path law, and the 16-child margin is absent there as well.

This is a finite certificate of that entrance model: a scoped obstruction and a failed search for a monotone producer on these pins. It is not a complete multiplication theorem. The selected exponent stays where it is.

Remaining obligations: one legal up/down/up centre trace, and an entrance count on the #4470 frames.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf` (upstream `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main). Dependency pins are in `research/rank8-u2-entrance-obstruction/SOURCES.json`: `ceiling.py` blob `6c0f54527d879396f689523bfde19928a9b6157c`, selected word gzip blob `723decbca8995e916d6f4b783aa3e1ddd4eb47fe`.

Task card `complex-new-helper-inventory`, priority revision 7. Scope status is **refined**. The card asks for a new helper inventory whose fully charged profile beats the packing ceiling. This package answers the still-open literal rank-at-most-8 producer inside the published 16-child slack and stops at the entrance obstruction.

Session r31, item 9 of the ordered list recorded in `research/f2-six-difference-basis` (open handoffs from the 19 October index, then open priority-table rows, then remaining catalogue cards). Item 10 of that list is #4651 and is dropped. The list is restated in the package README.

This is open question 2 of `research/rank8-u2-split-boundary` (#4151). Question 1 of that package, which integer splits of 896 still pass 16 extra rank-1 children, stays open. #4156 prices a plane-port screen against the same slack. #4158 records that the published selected word emits no paid child above rank 8. The monotone slot count is the remaining producer question those three leave open.

`python3 scripts/find_overlap.py` on 2026-10-23, terms `8:648`, `monotone rank-8 slot`, `entrance obstruction`, `rank-at-most-8 producer`. Coverage: local notes complete at `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf` (7091 head records), 307 open PRs, 4479 discussion records, both paginations complete. Closed PRs were searched through local READMEs and TASK metadata. No other note states this histogram. Same-day fork branches for the L546 six-tape bill, the R437 parent blank-return, the shared chart-1 centre visit, the SOURCE87 fibre count, and the #4091 1090-call ceiling price other rows.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/rank8-u2-entrance-obstruction/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank8-u2-entrance-obstruction
```

Observed:

```text
PASS_RANK8_U2_ENTRANCE_OBSTRUCTION slots=648 monotone=GT/0 centre3=LT/0/GT/1 ideal=LT/16/GT/17 no_new_kappa
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/rank8-u2-entrance-obstruction outcome=negative-result
```

The checker hashes `ceiling.py` (`86a1432870b3b21d8454106ec9162fddc0471472d9214c590a1420f2426cedfc`), the word gzip (`49596aa4ed4fd36cd4582fd0e8ddeb09fd80370a7d8aea1ede52a135b536d289`) and the decompressed word (`c2b294300760e1fd6eeab8c22c4d13e4633dca40e52cac8da0d68163a76e3ca8`). It rebuilds the 704 entrance rooms, packs both histograms, and separates every merge and transfer inequality on ranks 1..8 by the pinned outward enclosures. The ideal control reproduces the published boundary: 16 added rank-1 children pass and 17 fail. The capacity census is `{9:288, 8:360, 5:32, 4:24}`.

Not run: Lean, Docker, the selected cold replay, and any search for a non-monotone scalar word.

## Credit

The 16/17 integer boundary and the cell `{8:698, 2:1}` are ToikY's `research/lever-integer-twins`, following Nick Petalas's PR #3874. The entrance fields and the \(\mathbb{F}_2^9\) frame contract are the selected k8 word in `research/r480-owner-optimum`, as read by the frame-ceiling line (PR #1671, Gareth Davidson, using navinor's frame method). The child-cost enclosures are Douglas Colkitt's `research/complex-local-word-ceiling`, with Claude assistance. The coverage identity is PR #1012. The split dependence of the ideal slack is `research/rank8-u2-split-boundary`. The plane-port screen is `research/rank8-u2-plane-port-slack`.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0. No independent human review and no formal-kernel acceptance are claimed.

## Open next questions

1. Can one centre register legally emit three rank-8 steps, and can that word avoid every added rank-1 child? The arithmetic room of the comparison is zero: the bare moment passes and one aggregate rank-1 child fails. The first step is one explicit up, down, up frame trace and its own paid histogram. The standing monotone contract is the blocker.
2. Do the #4470 productive-helper frames have at least as many monotone rank-8 slots as that invoice demands? The first step is the same entrance count on the #4470 complex frames. The blocker is that the two templates must stay separate.
